This book illustrates how AI tools and techniques can enhance and refine these approaches, and critically examines the intersection of AI with ethical and sustainable design principles.

Integrating AI at the cross section of futures thinking and strategic foresight, this book goes beyond conventional boundaries, providing an unparalleled synthesis of AI with speculative and strategic foresight methodologies. You’ll discover that it’s not just about the tools and technologies; but about envisioning and shaping sustainable and ethically responsible futures.

Uniquely positioned at the intersection of deep theoretical insights and practical application, Designing Our Future offers a comprehensive understanding of the principles of futures thinking and strategic foresight coupled with actionable methodologies. This balance of depth and practicality sets this book apart in the field of futures studies and design thinking.

What You Will Learn

Understand the foundations and evolution of futures thinking, strategic foresight, and design
Integrate AI into futures thinking methodologies and develop innovative and ethical design processes
Apply theoretical knowledge of futures studies in real-world settings
Create prototypes and strategies that are informed by futures design and AI integration

Who this Book Is For

Design professionals, business managers, strategists, and students as well as policymakers and corporate leaders.

Integrando la IA en la sección transversal del pensamiento futuro y la previsión estratégica, este libro va más allá de los límites convencionales, proporcionando una síntesis sin igual de la IA con metodologías especulativas y estratégicas de previsión. Usted descubrirá que no es sólo acerca de las herramientas y las tecnologías, sino sobre la concepción y configuración de futuros sostenibles y éticamente responsables.

Únicamente posicionado en la intersección de profundas ideas teóricas y aplicación práctica, Designing Our Future ofrece una comprensión integral de los principios de pensamiento futuro y previsión estratégica junto con metodologías factibles. Este equilibrio de profundidad y practicidad distingue este libro en el campo de futuros estudios y pensamiento de diseño.

Integrar la IA en futuras metodologías de pensamiento y desarrollar procesos de diseño innovadores y éticos
Aplicar el conocimiento teórico de futuros estudios en escenarios del mundo real
Crear prototipos y estrategias que sean informados por futuros diseño e integración de IA

The book blends executive strategy with hands-on cybersecurity methodologies, providing a holistic understanding for CXOs, CISOs, and IT security professionals.

By exploring real-world case studies and breaches, such as SolarWinds and Colonial Pipeline, this book equips you with proactive defense strategies, governance insights, and the technical knowledge required to secure enterprise infrastructures effectively.

 

What You Will Learn

Align cybersecurity with business strategy and executive decision making
Cover practical implementation of frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and Zero Trust
Respond to cyber incidents and build a resilient security culture
Understand key cybersecurity principles, including threat intelligence and risk management

title: The Art of Creating Self-Organizing Teams : Agile Team Coaching from a Journeyman to an Expert
description:
The book centers on the art of team coaching specifically for Scrum Masters or Agile practitioners leading teams. This topic remains largely unexamined by the literature as there is a lack of contemporary guidance about coaching Agile teams on acquiring qualities paramount for an adaptive organization – being self-organized and assuming ownership over their ways of working and its results. An Agile practitioner has to either study books on professional coaching that don’t provide much information on working in the Agile context or try to implement Agile methodologies and frameworks with fragmented and limited guidance on dealing with teams and group dynamics.

By integrating coaching principles with the realities of an Agile environment, this book provides enough information and relevant case studies to equip a reader with the skills needed to organize coaching, confidently deal with emerging dynamics, and achieve the intended goals. It also connects Agile team coaching with the ICF (International Coaching Federation) Team Coaching competencies, professionalizing the practice.

In Agile ways of working, the team's strength significantly impacts the success of the products they work on. While Agile practitioners are adept at understanding methodologies, frameworks, tools, complementary practices and techniques, many lack coaching skills that address the human aspects of teamwork. This book fills that gap by empowering to effectively coach teams, leading to improved communication and cohesion, increased adaptability, and a culture of continuous improvement.

This book is practical, insightful, and it aims to support not only beginners but also seasoned professionals aspiring to elevate their practice.

What You Will Learn

Practical team coaching techniques for Agile contexts

Understanding and navigating complex dynamics

Systemic awareness and interventions

 

Who This Book is For

The primary audience for the book includes Scrum Masters and Agile practitioners aiming to improve their team’s performance. These professionals typically hold roles such as Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or Team Lead.
translatedDescription:
El libro se centra en el arte del entrenamiento de equipo específicamente para los equipos líderes de Scrum Masters o Agile practitioners. Este tema sigue sin examinarse en gran medida por la literatura, ya que la falta de orientación contemporánea sobre la capacitación de equipos ágiles sobre la adquisición de cualidades primordiales para una organización adaptativa, siendo autoorganizada y asumiendo la propiedad sobre sus formas de trabajo y sus resultados. Un practicante ágil tiene que estudiar libros sobre coaching profesional que no proporcionan mucha información sobre el trabajo en el contexto ágil o tratar de implementar metodologías y marcos ágiles con orientación fragmentada y limitada sobre el tratamiento de equipos y dinámicas de grupo.

Al integrar los principios de coaching con las realidades de un entorno ágil, este libro proporciona suficiente información y estudios de casos relevantes para equipar a un lector con las habilidades necesarias para organizar el coaching, lidiar con la dinámica emergente y alcanzar los objetivos previstos. También conecta el equipo Agile entrenando con las competencias del ICF (Federación Internacional de Entrenamiento) Team Coaching, profesionalizando la práctica.

En formas ágiles de trabajar, la fuerza del equipo impacta significativamente el éxito de los productos en los que trabajan. Si bien los practicantes agiles son adeptos en la comprensión de metodologías, marcos, herramientas, prácticas y técnicas complementarias, muchos carecen de habilidades de capacitación que aborden los aspectos humanos del trabajo en equipo. Este libro llena esa brecha facultando para capacitar eficazmente a los equipos, dando lugar a una mejor comunicación y cohesión, una mayor adaptabilidad y una cultura de mejora continua.

Este libro es práctico, perspicaz, y pretende apoyar no sólo a principiantes sino también a profesionales experimentados que aspiran a elevar su práctica.

Qué aprenderás

Técnicas prácticas de entrenamiento de equipos para contextos ágiles

Comprender y navegar dinámicas complejas

Sensibilización e intervenciones sistemáticas



Quién es este libro

El público principal del libro incluye Masters Scrum y practicantes ágiles con el objetivo de mejorar el rendimiento de su equipo. Estos profesionales suelen desempeñar funciones como Scrum Master, Agile Coach o Team Lead.

title: Large Language Models Ops for Finance: A Practical Guide to Infrastructure, Implementation, and Innovation
description:
Explore emerging technologies and the evolving role of AI in finance. Geared toward finance professionals, this book will equip you with the knowledge and tools to harness the power of Large Language Models (LLMs), ensuring you stay ahead in an increasingly AI-driven industry.

Highlighting the benefits and challenges of LLMs in financial contexts, the book starts with the necessary infrastructure setup, covering both hardware and software requirements. It offers a balanced discussion on cloud versus on-premises solutions, enabling you to make informed decisions based on their specific needs. Training and fine-tuning LLMs are critical components of effective deployment, and this book offers best practices, from data preparation to advanced fine-tuning techniques. It also delves into deployment strategies, with practical advice on building deployment pipelines, monitoring performance, and optimizing operations.

Ensuring data privacy and security is paramount in finance, so you’ll take a close look at maintaining compliance with regulations while safeguarding sensitive information. You’ll also examine the integration of LLMs into existing financial systems, with real-world case studies and strategies for API development and real-time data processing. Monitoring and maintenance are crucial for long-term success, and the book outlines how to manage performance metrics, handle model drift, and ensure regular updates. Large Language Models Ops for Finance is your essential guide to discovering the transformative potential of LLMs in the finance industry.  

What You Will Learn

●        Review LLMs and their applications in finance.

●        Set up the infrastructure for training and deploying LLMs.

●        Apply best practices for fine-tuning and maintaining LLMs.

●        Employ techniques for integrating LLMs into existing financial systems

Who This Book Is For

AI and ML engineers, data scientists, and finance professionals interested in implementing and managing large language models within the finance industry.
translatedDescription:
Explore las tecnologías emergentes y el papel cambiante de la IA en las finanzas. Engranada hacia profesionales de finanzas, este libro le equipará con los conocimientos y herramientas para aprovechar el poder de los modelos de lenguajes grandes (LLMs), asegurando que siga adelante en una industria cada vez más impulsada por IA.

Destacando los beneficios y retos de las LLMs en contextos financieros, el libro comienza con la configuración necesaria de infraestructura, cubriendo tanto los requisitos de hardware como software. Ofrece una discusión equilibrada sobre soluciones cloud versus on-premises, lo que le permite tomar decisiones informadas basadas en sus necesidades específicas. La capacitación y el ajuste de las LM son componentes fundamentales del despliegue eficaz, y este libro ofrece mejores prácticas, desde la preparación de datos hasta técnicas avanzadas de ajuste. También se desvía en las estrategias de despliegue, con asesoramiento práctico sobre la construcción de oleoductos de despliegue, el seguimiento del desempeño y la optimización de las operaciones.

Garantizar la privacidad y la seguridad de los datos es fundamental en las finanzas, por lo que echará un vistazo a mantener el cumplimiento de las regulaciones al tiempo que salvaguarda la información confidencial. También examinará la integración de las LLM en los sistemas financieros existentes, con estudios de casos en el mundo real y estrategias para el desarrollo de API y el procesamiento de datos en tiempo real. El monitoreo y mantenimiento son cruciales para el éxito a largo plazo, y el libro describe cómo gestionar las métricas de rendimiento, manejar la deriva modelo y asegurar actualizaciones regulares. Grandes modelos de lenguaje Ops for Finance es su guía esencial para descubrir el potencial transformador de LLMs en la industria financiera.

Qué aprenderás

- Revisar los LLM y sus aplicaciones en finanzas.

● Establecer la infraestructura para la capacitación y el despliegue de LLMs.

● Aplicar las mejores prácticas para perfeccionar y mantener las LM.

● Técnicas de empleo para integrar las LM en los sistemas financieros existentes

Quién es este libro

Ingenieros de IA y ML, científicos de datos y profesionales financieros interesados en implementar y gestionar modelos de idiomas grandes dentro de la industria financiera.

title: Appium Insights: Strategies for Successful Platform Agnostic Test Automation
description:
This books helps you embark on the journey to master the art of Appium automation, from installation all the way to building a Plugin and Driver. It covers the Appium 3.0 version which is the latest version which involves a complete re-architecture. 

You'll begin by following step-by-step instructions on installing Appium, configuring Node packages, and creating a simple test. In these initial chapters, you'll gain an understanding of Appium Architecture and the command lifecycle. Once you understand the basics, the book will then guide you in testing automation for Android and iOS, both for real devices and for emulators. These chapters also provide instructions on how to run tests in parallel, native shell commands, and how to prepare iOS real devices for test automation. Chapters also cover low-level technical implementations, which will enable you to contribute to Appium and open a way to open-source software contributions.

Following this, you'll discuss the intricacies of configuring and developing robust method wrappers, a crucial skill for supporting multiple test suites with both native commands. The book goes beyond the basics, exploring techniques to make test suites faster when running tests in CI like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, as well as cloud environments like Lambda Test, BrowserStack. It will also help you understand advanced topics such as gestures, plugin development, and continuous testing in CI environments.

By the end of this book, you'll have developed the expertise to debug Appium command failures and construct a sophisticated test automation framework, as well as excel in your Appium test automation endeavours and deliver reliable, efficient testing solutions.

What You'll Learn:

Master advanced techniques in Appium Mobile Test Automation.
Solve common challenges encountered in real-world projects and strategize to overcome them.
Test automation for various platforms like TV apps, Roku, Raspberry Pi, and more.
Contribute to the Appium project and engage in open-source contributions.

Who is this book for:

Software Testers, software architects, QA engineers, and DevOps engineers
translatedDescription:
Este libro le ayuda a embarcarse en el viaje para dominar el arte de la automatización de Appium, desde la instalación hasta la construcción de un Plugin y Driver. Cubre la versión Appium 3.0 que es la última versión que implica una re-arquitectura completa.

Comenzarás siguiendo instrucciones paso a paso para instalar Appium, configurar paquetes Node y crear una prueba simple. En estos capítulos iniciales, obtendrá una comprensión de Appium Architecture y del ciclo de vida de comando. Una vez que entiendas lo básico, el libro te guiará en la automatización de pruebas para Android e iOS, tanto para dispositivos reales como para emuladores. Estos capítulos también proporcionan instrucciones sobre cómo ejecutar pruebas en paralelo, comandos nativos de shell, y cómo preparar dispositivos reales iOS para la automatización de pruebas. Los capítulos también cubren implementaciones técnicas de bajo nivel, que le permitirán contribuir a Appium y abrir una manera de contribuciones de software de código abierto.

Después de esto, usted discutirá las complejidades de configurar y desarrollar envoltorios de métodos robustos, una habilidad crucial para apoyar múltiples suites de prueba con ambos comandos nativos. El libro va más allá de lo básico, explorando técnicas para hacer las suites de prueba más rápido al realizar pruebas en CI como Jenkins, GitHub Actions, así como entornos de nube como Lambda Test, BrowserStack. También te ayudará a entender temas avanzados como gestos, desarrollo de plugins y pruebas continuas en entornos CI.

Al final de este libro, habrá desarrollado la experiencia para depurar fallas de comandos Appium y construir un sofisticado marco de automatización de pruebas, así como sobresalir en sus esfuerzos de automatización de pruebas de Appium y ofrecer soluciones de prueba fiables y eficientes.

Lo que aprenderás:

Técnicas avanzadas maestras en Appium Mobile Test Automation.
Resuelva los desafíos comunes encontrados en proyectos del mundo real y estrategue para superarlos.
Automatización de pruebas para varias plataformas como aplicaciones de TV, Roku, Raspberry Pi y más.
Contribuir al proyecto Appium y participar en contribuciones de código abierto.

¿Quién es este libro para:

Testers de software, arquitectos de software, ingenieros de QA y ingenieros de DevOps

title: Make It Snow: From Zero to Billions
description:
Follow along on the journey of the founding, development, and breakaway success of a multi-billion-dollar tech company

Founding Snowflake CRO, Chris Degnan, and CMO, Denise Persson, have one of the longest executive sales and marketing relationships in history. They each built their teams from the ground up to help catapult Snowflake from a startup to one of the fastest-growing technology companies. Along the way, they evolved, innovated and executed as a single entity to deliver impact, while aligning with Snowflake's number one company value: put customers first. Learn how Chris and Denise united two historically divided teams in Corporate America to achieve long-lasting customer relationships and enduring company success.

This book covers Snowflake' sales and marketing evolution through three phases of the company: Startup, Build and Scale. Readers will learn:

How and when to jumpstart your sales and marketing teams.
How to develop product market fit and your competitive strategy.
Why business partners are critical to sales success.
The importance of establishing a culture early, and how.
Why demand gen should be marketing's northern star.
What success looks like when hiring, retaining and saying goodbye.
Building for a billion: restructuring sales, scaling a data-driven marketing team.

This book targets startup founders and executives, venture capital partners and the boards of directors of early- and mid-stage technology startups. Sales and marketing are often neglected in these companies, with focus squarely placed on engineering and product teams that determine sales and marketing functions. There is a better way. Armed with the strategies and tactics contained in this book, senior stakeholders of startup companies can jump-start and align their sales and marketing go-to-market strategy sooner and with more impact.

Cada uno construyó sus equipos desde el suelo para ayudar a catapulta Snowflake de una startup a una de las empresas tecnológicas de más rápido crecimiento. A lo largo del camino, evolucionaron, innovaron y ejecutaron como una sola entidad para ofrecer impacto, alineando con el valor de compañía número uno de Snowflake: poner primero a los clientes. Descubra cómo Chris y Denise unieron dos equipos históricamente divididos en América Corporativa para lograr relaciones de clientes duraderas y éxito de la compañía.

Cómo y cuándo saltar sus equipos de ventas y marketing.
Cómo desarrollar el mercado de productos adecuado y su estrategia competitiva.
Por qué los socios de negocios son críticos para el éxito de las ventas.
La importancia de establecer una cultura temprano, y cómo.
¿Por qué demandar al gen debería ser la estrella norte de marketing?
Qué éxito parece al contratar, retener y despedirse.
Construcción para mil millones: ventas de reestructuración, escalando un equipo de marketing basado en datos.

Armados con las estrategias y tácticas contenidas en este libro, los principales interesados de las empresas de startup pueden iniciarse y alinear su estrategia de ventas y marketing para ir al mercado antes y con más impacto.

title: Generative Art and Computer Vision: A Comprehensive Guide for Artists
description:
Understand how to combine computer vision and generative art. The book shows how computer vision methods can be applied to art.

The book will start with an introductory chapter on computer vision and generative art followed by chapters on specific means of producing genre artworks generatively. The following seven chapters deal with the seven traditional bases for art education (i.e., elements of art: line, value, color, shape, texture, form, and space); each will show specifically how machine vision and computer graphic methods can be applied to that element.

The book provides a comprehensive view of combining machine vision and art; some of the code provided has no analogy elsewhere. The book is intended to explain:

What exactly is generative art?
What does a generative artist do and know?
How does one start creating generative artwork?
What resources are out there to help artists who are not really programmers, or programmers who are not really artist?

 

You Will 

Find out about extracting line data from images as well as drawing lines
Understand contrast and brightness enhancements
Learn about subtractive color schemes and Munsell color in a practical way

 

Who Is This Book For

Generative artists who don't program well or at all will greatly appreciate this book. There will be plenty of material for those who do not code, including simple code and an appendix to help them get started.

El libro comenzará con un capítulo introductorio sobre la visión informática y el arte generativo seguido de capítulos sobre medios específicos de producir obras de género generativamente. Los siguientes siete capítulos tratan de las siete bases tradicionales para la educación artística (es decir, elementos de arte: línea, valor, color, forma, textura, forma y espacio); cada uno mostrará específicamente cómo la visión de la máquina y los métodos gráficos de la computadora se pueden aplicar a ese elemento.

El libro ofrece una visión completa de combinar la visión de la máquina y el arte; parte del código proporcionado no tiene analogía en otro lugar. El libro está destinado a explicar:

¿Qué es exactamente el arte generativo?
¿Qué hace y sabe un artista generativo?
¿Cómo se empieza a crear obras de arte generativas?
¿Qué recursos hay para ayudar a artistas que no son realmente programadores, o programadores que no son realmente artistas?



Lo harás.

Descubra acerca de la extracción de datos de línea de imágenes así como líneas de dibujo
Comprender los aumentos de contraste y brillo
Aprender acerca de los esquemas de color subtráctico y el color Munsell de una manera práctica



¿Quién es este libro para

Artistas generadores que no programan bien o en absoluto apreciarán mucho este libro. Habrá un montón de material para aquellos que no código, incluyendo código simple y un apéndice para ayudarles a empezar.

title: Applied Time Series Analysis for the Social Sciences
description:
EXPLORE THIS INDISPENSABLE AND COMPREHENSIVE GUIDE TO TIME SERIES ANALYSIS FOR STUDENTS AND PRACTITIONERS IN A WIDE VARIETY OF DISCIPLINES

Applied Time Series Analysis for the Social Sciences: Specification, Estimation, and Inference delivers an accessible guide to time series analysis that includes both theory and practice. The coverage spans developments from ARIMA intervention models and generalized least squares to the London School of Economics (LSE) approach and vector autoregression. Designed to break difficult concepts into manageable pieces while offering plenty of examples and exercises, the author demonstrates the use of lag operator algebra throughout to provide a better understanding of dynamic specification and the connections between model specifications that appear to be more different than they are.

The book is ideal for those with minimal mathematical experience, intended to follow a course in multiple regression, and includes exercises designed to build general skills such as mathematical expectation calculations to derive means and variances. Readers will also benefit from the inclusion of:

A focus on social science applications and a mix of theory and detailed examples provided throughout
An accompanying website with data sets and examples in Stata, SAS and R
A simplified unit root testing strategy based on recent developments
An examination of various uses and interpretations of lagged dependent variables and the common pitfalls students and researchers face in this area
An introduction to LSE methodology such as the COMFAC critique, general-to-specific modeling, and the use of forecasting to evaluate and test models

Perfect for students and professional researchers in the political sciences, public policy, sociology, and economics, Applied Time Series Analysis for the Social Sciences: Specification, Estimation, and Inference will also earn a place in the libraries of post graduate students and researchers in public health, public administration and policy, and education.
translatedDescription:
EXPLOREO ESTA GUÍA INDISPENSABLE Y COMPREVIVA A LOS SERIE DE TIEMPOS ANÁLISIS PARA ESTUDIANTES Y PRACTICIONADORES EN UN VARIETÍA DE DISCIPLINES

Análisis de la serie de tiempo aplicado para las ciencias sociales: Especificación, estimación e inferencia ofrece una guía accesible al análisis de series temporales que incluye tanto la teoría como la práctica. La cobertura abarca los desarrollos de los modelos de intervención de ARIMA y los mínimos cuadrados generalizados al enfoque de la Escuela de Economía de Londres (LSE) y autoregreso vectorial. Diseñado para romper conceptos difíciles en piezas manejables al tiempo que ofrece muchos ejemplos y ejercicios, el autor demuestra el uso de álgebra de operador de lag a lo largo de todo para proporcionar una mejor comprensión de la especificación dinámica y las conexiones entre las especificaciones modelo que parecen ser más diferentes de lo que son.

El libro es ideal para aquellos con experiencia matemática mínima, destinados a seguir un curso en regresión múltiple, e incluye ejercicios diseñados para construir habilidades generales como cálculos de expectativa matemática para derivar medios y diferencias. Los lectores también se beneficiarán de la inclusión de:

Un enfoque en las aplicaciones de la ciencia social y una combinación de teoría y ejemplos detallados proporcionados a lo largo de todo el mundo
Un sitio web acompañante con conjuntos de datos y ejemplos en Stata, SAS y R
Una estrategia simplificada de evaluación de la base basada en acontecimientos recientes
Un examen de diversos usos e interpretaciones de variables dependientes y los obstáculos comunes que enfrentan los estudiantes e investigadores en esta área
Introducción a la metodología LSE como la crítica COMFAC, el modelado general a específico, y el uso de pronósticos para evaluar y probar modelos

Perfecto para estudiantes e investigadores profesionales en ciencias políticas, política pública, sociología y economía, Análisis de la serie de tiempo aplicado para las ciencias sociales: Especificación, estimación e inferencia también ganará un lugar en las bibliotecas de estudiantes e investigadores post graduados en salud pública, administración pública y política, y educación.

title: Kotlin Brain Teasers
description:
Can you outsmart the Kotlin compiler? Detect, deduce, and diagnose your way to clearer code and expert insights. Escape type-system traps and navigate logic labyrinths. Challenge your skills and quiz your friends with fun Kotlin facts, and power up your code with nuanced mastery of data types, functions, and programming techniques. Stay sharp, know your threats, and reason critically to fix bugs before they happen. Laugh at unexpected outcomes and puzzle over awkward edge cases, then ace your next interview with memorable payoffs that simplify key concepts in Kotlin and computer science.

Put the fun in functions and laugh while you learn with programming puzzles that challenge your intuition and sharpen your skills. Guess each simple program’s output—if you can—then run the code or turn the page to find out what’s not as it seems. Deepen your understanding of key data types and put computer science in context as you make deductions and discoveries that will upgrade your apps. Play around and break things to uncover the deliberate design decisions behind Kotlin’s unexpected quirks and reveal the why, not just the what.

Take on the type system and smuggle null values past the compiler’s defenses. Overload operators and turn math on its head as you crack floating-point conundrums. Think like a computer and predict your program’s path when you test the limits of control-flow keywords. Harness the power of iteration and immutability to tame devious data and curate collections with confidence. Unravel ambiguous lambda functions and streamline inscrutable syntax. Dodge destructuring dilemmas, spot sneaky shadowing, and know the dynamic difference between members and extensions.

Prepare for interviews, tests, competitions, real-world projects, and more with powered-up problem-solving proficiency, improved coding confidence, and lasting Kotlin lessons. Most of all, have fun!

title: SAP ABAP 7.5 Optimization for HANA: AMDP, CDS and Native SQL for Peak Performance
description:
In the evolving landscape of SAP development, performance is no longer just a nice-to-have—it's a necessity. With the power of SAP HANA and the enhancements introduced in ABAP 7.5, developers are now equipped to rethink how applications are built, executed, and optimized. This book is your guide to that transformation.

We begin by understanding the core shift: moving data-intensive operations directly into the HANA database. When implemented correctly, this "code pushdown" philosophy dramatically reduces data transfer and processing overhead. AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures), our in-database processing engine, enables us to write complex logic directly in SQLScript, harnessing HANA’s parallel processing capabilities. We focus on crafting efficient AMDP procedures by adopting set-based operations and minimizing unnecessary data movement.

Next, we explore Core Data Services (CDS) Views, our go-to data modeling tool. CDS Views are not just simple database views; they act as semantic layers that define how our applications interact with data. We learn to create optimized CDS Views by leveraging associations, annotations, and table functions, enabling us to build reusable, high-performance data models. These views simplify complex queries, improve data consistency, and enhance application flexibility.

We then turn to Native SQL, our direct line to the HANA database. While AMDP and CDS Views provide powerful abstractions, Native SQL offers ultimate control for specialized tasks. We embed Native SQL within AMDP procedures to access database-specific features and fine-tune performance for critical operations. Along the way, we apply best practices for writing efficient queries, with a strong focus on indexing, join strategies, and precise data filtering.

Throughout this journey, we emphasize the importance of rigorous testing and proactive monitoring. Just like a race car undergoes extensive testing before hitting the track, our ABAP applications require careful validation to ensure accuracy and optimal performance. We explore techniques for unit testing AMDP procedures, validating CDS Views, and monitoring query performance. We also look at strategies for detecting and addressing potential bottlenecks before they affect end users.

SAP ABAP 7.5 Optimization for HANA is not just about writing faster code—it’s about fundamentally rethinking how we develop applications. By embracing code pushdown, leveraging AMDP, CDS Views, and Native SQL, and implementing robust testing and monitoring strategies, we build ABAP applications that are not only faster, but also more scalable, maintainable, and adaptable to the ever-evolving demands of modern business.

You Will:

Learn how to implement the "code pushdown" philosophy, moving data-intensive operations directly into the HANA database to reduce data transfer and processing overhead
Understand to create optimized CDS Views, leveraging associations, annotations, and table functions to build reusable, high-performance data models that simplify complex queries and improve data consistency.
Explore how to write complex logic directly in SQLScript using AMDP, harnessing HANA's parallel processing capabilities, and using Native SQL for specialized tasks, accessing database-specific features to optimize performance.

This Book is For:

ABAP Developers, SAP Consultants and Architects and IT Managers and Technical Leads

Este libro es su guía para esa transformación.

Comenzamos por entender el cambio de núcleo: el traslado de operaciones intensivas de datos directamente en la base de datos HANA. Cuando se implementa correctamente, esta filosofía de "impulsión de código" reduce drásticamente la transferencia de datos y el procesamiento de sobrecabeza. Luego nos dirigimos a Native SQL, nuestra línea directa a la base de datos HANA. También examinamos estrategias para detectar y abordar posibles obstáculos antes de que afecten a los usuarios finales.

SAP ABAP 7.5 Optimización para HANA no se trata sólo de escribir código más rápido, sino de repensar fundamentalmente cómo desarrollamos aplicaciones. Al abrazar la presión de código, aprovechando AMDP, CDS Views y Native SQL, e implementando estrategias robustas de pruebas y monitoreo, construimos aplicaciones ABAP que no son sólo más rápidas, sino también más escalables, sostenibles y adaptables a las exigencias cada vez más cambiantes de la empresa moderna.

Lo harás:

Aprenda a implementar la filosofía de "impulsión de código", moviendo operaciones de gran intensidad de datos directamente en la base de datos de HANA para reducir la transferencia de datos y procesar la sobrecabeza
Comprenda crear vistas de CDS optimizadas, asociaciones de palanca, anotaciones y funciones de tabla para crear modelos de datos reutilizables y de alto rendimiento que simplifican las consultas complejas y mejoran la coherencia de los datos.
Explore cómo escribir lógica compleja directamente en SQLScript usando AMDP, aprovechando las capacidades de procesamiento paralelo de HANA, y usando SQL nativo para tareas especializadas, accediendo a funciones específicas de base para optimizar el rendimiento.

Este libro es para:

ABAP Developers, SAP Consultants and Architects and IT Managers and Technical Leads

title: Leadership Unblocked
description:
A USA TODAY bestseller.

Your mindset may be the only thing standing between you and your potential. Break free from the beliefs that hold you back.

As a leader, do you find yourself frustrated, wondering why employees don't meet expectations, peers are slow to act, or pressure from your boss falls unfairly on your shoulders? It's easy to point a finger at others and double down on getting results. But have you ever considered that the problem might not be them—that it might be you?

Through countless hours coaching executives over the past twenty years, C-suite adviser Muriel M. Wilkins has pinpointed the biggest reason behind these common leadership challenges: hidden blockers. These unconscious beliefs can actively stall progress if leaders aren't aware of their existence, preventing them from seeing a situation clearly, solving problems effectively, and advancing their careers.

In Leadership Unblocked, Wilkins reveals seven key beliefs that hold leaders back, from "I know I'm right" to "I need to be involved" to "I don't belong here." Combining illustrative and powerful coaching conversations and research from the fields of neuroscience, leadership, and adult development theory, Wilkins offers a self-coaching guide for identifying, unpacking, and breaking through these barriers.

By using the practical advice in this book, leaders and aspiring leaders alike can cultivate the mindset to achieve their goals and finally become the leaders they want to be.

Un bestseller de USA TODAY.

Es fácil apuntar un dedo a los demás y doblarse en conseguir resultados. ¿Pero alguna vez has considerado que el problema podría no ser ellos, para que pudieras ser tú?

A través de innumerables horas entrenando a ejecutivos durante los últimos veinte años, el asesor de C-suite Muriel M. Wilkins ha señalado la razón más grande detrás de estos desafíos comunes de liderazgo: bloqueadores ocultos. Estas creencias inconscientes pueden retrasar activamente el progreso si los líderes no son conscientes de su existencia, impidiéndoles ver una situación claramente, resolver problemas eficazmente y avanzar en sus carreras.

En Liderazgo Desbloqueado, Wilkins revela siete creencias clave que retienen a los líderes, desde "Sé que tengo razón" a "Necesito involucrarme" a "No pertenezco aquí". Combinando conversaciones ilustrativas y poderosas de coaching e investigación desde los campos de la neurociencia, el liderazgo y la teoría del desarrollo adulto, Wilkins ofrece una guía para identificar, desempacar y romper estas barreras.

Utilizando el consejo práctico en este libro, líderes y aspirantes a líderes pueden cultivar la mentalidad para alcanzar sus objetivos y finalmente convertirse en los líderes que quieren ser.

title: Predictable Ops: Leading IT in the Age of AI
description:
Predictable Ops is a practical leadership framework for IT operations leaders and their business partners navigating the complexities of AI-driven transformation. The book delivers eight clear rules grouped into two tracks: Operational Trust and Preparation & Foresight. This system helps leaders build reliable, cost-aware, resilient services — and lead decisively when machine-driven insights must be balanced with human judgment.

Each rule includes real-world anecdotes — from cloud migrations and vendor licensing negotiations to critical incident communications and team accountability gaps. Predictable Ops makes the system repeatable through reflection questions, templates, and ‘Try It This Week’ actions.

Where other books focus narrowly on DevOps, SRE, or AI strategy, Predictable Ops bridges the daily realities of operations leaders who must stabilize services while explaining the risks and value of AI to partners who depend on them.

With trust, clear forecasting, transparent communication, and decisive leadership, Predictable Ops shows readers how to deliver services that stay stable, boring, and trusted — so that AI and future platforms multiply value instead of chaos.
translatedDescription:

El libro ofrece ocho reglas claras agrupadas en dos temas: la Confianza Operacional y la Preparación " Previsión. Este sistema ayuda a los líderes a construir servicios fiables, conscientes de costos y resistentes, y liderar decisivamente cuando las ideas impulsadas por la máquina deben ser equilibradas con el juicio humano.

Cada regla incluye anécdotas del mundo real, desde las migraciones en la nube y las negociaciones de licencias de proveedores hasta las comunicaciones de incidentes críticos y las lagunas en la rendición de cuentas de los equipos. Predictable Ops hace que el sistema sea repetible a través de preguntas de reflexión, plantillas y acciones de “Try It This Week”.

Cuando otros libros se centran estrechamente en DevOps, SRE o estrategia AI, Predictable Ops puentea las realidades cotidianas de los líderes de operaciones que deben estabilizar los servicios al tiempo que explica los riesgos y el valor de AI a los socios que dependen de ellos.

Con confianza, previsiones claras, comunicación transparente y liderazgo decisivo, Predictable Ops muestra a los lectores cómo ofrecer servicios que permanecen estables, aburridos y confiables, de modo que las plataformas de IA y futuras se multipliquen el valor en lugar del caos.

title: Empowerment for All
description:
An exciting new discussion of empowerment strategies that work in the real world

In Empowerment for All, veteran tech executive and Director of Products for All at Google, Annie Jean-Baptiste, delivers a groundbreaking new approach to innovation and change management for all business professionals, not just executives and human resources practitioners. Jean-Baptiste explains how people of any experience level can use their individual voices and experiences to help everyone in their organization actively and fully participate.

The book offers hands-on strategies for creating a workplace where everyone feels seen, validated, and uplifted. Its unique approach democratizes the empowerment process and proves that meaningful change starts with each person.

You’ll also find:

Actionable insights and techniques that draw on the author’s extensive expertise in tech, fashion, and design
Strategies for creating products and services that cater to untapped markets
Illustrations of how embracing individuality and lived experiences can foster empathy and human-centered design

Perfect for executives, managers, entrepreneurs, founders, and other business leaders, Empowerment for All is also a must-read for anyone interested in creating more inclusive teams, companies, and communities for everyone to be able to reach their full potential.

Jean-Baptiste explica cómo las personas de cualquier nivel de experiencia pueden utilizar sus voces y experiencias individuales para ayudar a todos en su organización activamente y participar plenamente.

El libro ofrece estrategias prácticas para crear un lugar de trabajo donde todos se sientan vistos, validados y elevados. Su enfoque único democratiza el proceso de empoderamiento y demuestra que el cambio significativo comienza con cada persona.

También encontrará:

Perspicacias y técnicas que se basan en la amplia experiencia del autor en tecnología, moda y diseño

title: Procedural 3D Modeling Using Geometry Nodes in Blender - Second Edition

Explore the world of procedural 3D modeling within Blender using the versatile Geometry Nodes system. Build your proficiency and confidence working with Geometry Nodes through engaging, hands-on projects and practical demonstrations.

Develop a solid understanding of Geometry Nodes inputs, outputs, and fundamental operations.
Master procedural modeling and animate dynamic systems using Blender's simulation tools.
Create realistic, math-based physics simulations for animated objects and systems.
Apply procedural techniques to generate intricate geometries such as plants, walls, and architectural elements.
Learn to troubleshoot and optimize complex node networks for improved performance and results.

Author(s)

Siemen Lens is an accomplished 3D artist and educator with extensive experience in Blender and procedural modeling. Aspiring CG (computer graphics) professionals will find this book's project-based approach an exciting way to advance their skills.

title: Nanoelectronics
description:
Nanoelectronics is an essential resource for anyone looking to stay at the forefront of innovation, as it thoroughly explores cutting-edge methodologies and design principles for ultra-nanoscale technology.

Modern research aims to make devices more efficient so that next-level systems will be energy-efficient, have faster operating speeds, and occupy minimal space. Traditional methods for the implementation of systems are approaching their fundamental limitations. The field of ultra-nanoscale technology is a prime choice for researchers to work and develop technologies for future systems. The advantages of the ultra-nanoscale field are low-dimensional and high-speed implementation with a focus on high levels of functional integration.

Nanoelectronics: Fundamentals, Advances, and Applications comprehensively covers both introductory and advanced-level ideas and methodologies, which support future system designs in ultra-nanoscale technologies. The merits and challenges of different technological devices and systems are also discussed in depth. This book focuses on design and techniques for the next generation of intelligent systems, making it an essential resource for novices and experts exploring this innovative technology.
translatedDescription:

La investigación moderna pretende hacer que los dispositivos sean más eficientes para que los sistemas de próximo nivel sean eficientes en energía, tengan velocidades de funcionamiento más rápidas y ocupen un espacio mínimo. Los métodos tradicionales para la aplicación de los sistemas están abordando sus limitaciones fundamentales. El campo de la tecnología ultrananoscale es una opción primordial para que los investigadores trabajen y desarrollen tecnologías para sistemas futuros. Las ventajas del campo ultrananoscale son la implementación de baja dimensión y alta velocidad con énfasis en altos niveles de integración funcional.

Nanoelectrónica: Fundamentos, Avances y Aplicaciones abarcan de manera integral las ideas y metodologías introductorias y avanzadas, que apoyan los diseños de sistemas futuros en tecnologías de ultrananoscale. Los méritos y retos de diferentes dispositivos y sistemas tecnológicos también se examinan a fondo. Este libro se centra en el diseño y las técnicas para la próxima generación de sistemas inteligentes, por lo que es un recurso esencial para principiantes y expertos que exploran esta innovadora tecnología.

title: The Value Vector: Building Scalable Generative AI-Based Applications
description:
Learn how to bring Generative AI applications to life, from conception to production, ensuring they deliver true business value. Follow Dr. Anya’s story as she implements AI in day-to-day business solutions, immersing you in the real challenges of AI-based product development and deployment. Through her journey and notes, you will experience a wide range of challenges and solutions firsthand, demonstrating how AI can be translated into compelling business cases, efficient technical architectures, and innovative applications.The book begins with you understanding the AI Value Compass – a strategic framework that will provide you with a structure for AI implementation. It then dives into AI-led innovation and how you can extract the most valuable and interesting ideas from the waves of creative thinking that emerges from your organization. It also addresses AI literacy, helping you guide your teams in using AI to tackle the most pressing business challenges. Next, you will find a roadmap for creating a Proof of Concept for your AI application that don’t become outdated before review, showing how to build solutions that deliver value rapidly and efficiently. The journey continues as Dr. Anya guides you from a POC to production, teaching how to scale Generative AI applications for enterprise deployment. The book then tackles governance, security, and ethics - all of which are crucial aspects for implementing AI responsibly and sustainably. The final chapter explores the next wave of AI, introducing you to the era of AI agents.   This book, by providing a comprehensive guide that combines practical advice, ethical considerations, and an incredibly engaging narrative, aims to equip you with the knowledge and tools you will need to successfully implement Generative AI projects that deliver real business value.

What You Will Learn:

How to identify and prioritize valuable generative AI use cases that help organizations create a path to value
Techniques for developing effective POCs and transitioning to full-scale production , including architectural considerations for enterprise readiness
Essential ethical considerations in AI-based solution development and strategies to prevent misuse
Select, fine-tune and integrate AI models and avoid common pitfalls

Who is this book for: Professionals involved in AI product development and deployment, including developers, architects, project managers, business analysts, and CXOs.

title: Modernizing Core Infrastructure for AI-Ready SaaS Applications
description:
Building, maintaining, and optimizing a scalable and resilient SaaS/ASP architecture isn't easy. Organizations report significant impediments to their full digital potential, including infrastructure complexity, tool and API sprawl, and laborious manual operational tasks. And while AI automation is key to scaling faster, operating leaner, and staying secure, it's not enough. Core application infrastructure components must auto-scale, meet applicable compliance mandates, provide robust protection, and offer rich XOps capabilities in order to provide agility while reducing operational toil.

This report lays out best practices for managing infrastructure, automation toolchains, and security controls to help the largest organizations maximize the value of their customer-facing applications.

Understand the foundational elements of application architecture within SaaS/ASP tech stacks
Discover why core infrastructure services must be differentiated and secure
Learn how AI will impact your business and unlock insights to streamline operations
Determine the best tools for application architecture and infrastructure/security/AI
Assess your risk posture and identify controls for mitigating compliance threats

title: Linux on Azure

title: Decision-Making Techniques and Methods for Sustainable Technological Innovation
The Devil Emails at Midnight
description:
Must read exposé of the 13 types of bad bosses to help you become a better leader

In The Devil Emails at Midnight: What Good Leaders Can Learn From Bad Bosses, Mita Mallick shares how bad bosses aren't born. Bad bosses are made. They are a product of their circumstances. She shares hilarious and heartbreaking stories of the 13 bad bosses she once endured and survived, even including when she was a bad boss in her career. She challenges us both current and aspiring leaders to avoid the pitfalls of bad boss behavior.

With powerful storytelling and practical advice, she covers bad behaviors like:

Never having time for our teams (except at midnight)
Micromanaging and re-doing all of the team’s work
Being completely disengaged, and disinterested in leading
Ruling with fear in hopes of driving business results
Loving the spotlight and taking credit for all of the work and much, much more
The Devil Emails at Midnight: What Good Leaders Can Learn From Bad Bosses is a must read guide on how not to become that bad boss for anyone on their journey to be a better leader. Mita reminds us that a good leader can be the difference maker: ensuring we are recognized and valued for our contributions in our organizations. So remember that the devil emails at midnight. Let's make sure that devil doesn't become you.

title: Confessions of an IT Scrum Master: Real Stories, Practical Tips, and Hard-Learned Lessons in Agile
description:
Explore themes often glossed over in traditional Agile texts: navigating the transition from a technical architect to a servant leader, handling conflicting priorities and leadership misalignments, and managing value delivery in client-driven environments where frameworks alone are not enough. This book is an honest and relatable look into the day-to-day realities of leading Agile teams—filled with hard-earned lessons, internal conflicts, and war stories from the trenches of IT service delivery. 

Many Agile professionals find themselves constrained by process rigidity, unable to adapt to real-world pressures. These topics are more relevant than ever, as enterprises demand agility in outcomes, not just ceremonies. This book offers timely guidance on how to focus on execution while remaining Agile in spirit. Structured as a series of thematic chapters based on real events and personal “confessions,” each section ends with reflection questions and actionable takeaways. The narrative style guarantees engagement, while the learnings guarantee impact. 

Unlike traditional guides that idealize Agile or limit themselves to theory, Confessions of an IT Scrum Master acknowledges the gray areas and equips you to navigate them with confidence. Its confession-style storytelling is not only compelling but also deeply authentic—because it’s written by someone who’s lived it.

What You Will Learn

The practical gaps between Agile theory and enterprise execution
How internal conflicts (e.g., architect vs. Scrum Master) affect delivery
Techniques to focus on value delivery in process-heavy environments

·       Who This Book is For

Intermediate Agile professionals

title: Take Control of Apple Wallet
description:
Master the Swiss army knife of stored cards and passes Version 1.1, updated February 5, 2026

If you ever felt frustrated using Wallet for the iPhone or Apple Watch, Take Control of Apple Wallet is for you. Glenn Fleishman walks you through everything Wallet can do, which has grown to be quite a lot over the years. You learn to add and manage payment cards, track orders, work with digital keys, install transit passes, and much more.

“A book about Wallet? Really? Are you pulling my leg? Shouldn’t an app that just holds payment cards and store/membership cards be simple enough to use without a 100-plus-page book?”

Look, that’s what we thought, too, but we kept running up against pain points in Wallet for iPhone and Apple Watch, along with Apple Pay nuances, that took us aback. And we kept finding obscured features that we had to dig for. In particular, both author Glenn Fleishman and editor Joe Kissell kept saying “huh!” and then documenting that “huh” so you don’t say it, too.

In the end, Glenn dissects Wallet, pulling its virtual pieces apart, so you can use more of its surprisingly rich set of offerings, and avoid bumping against what it doesn’t do—particularly when there’s no error or feedback about why it’s not working.

While the iPhone’s Wallet app bulges the most with features and options, Glenn thoroughly covers the Wallet app on the Apple Watch. He also explains where the Wallet & Apple Pay settings on an iPad and Mac fit in, since you can use and manage Apple Pay and autofillable cards on those two operating systems as well.

The book covers these topics:

Understand how Apple organizes wallet on an iPhone and Apple Watch.
Configure the many Wallet options, scattered around the app and Settings.
Work with payment cards, exploring the details available when a card is added.
Get to know AutoFill cards, and how they differ from Apple Pay payment cards.
Learn about how Apple Pay protects card security, and the many ways you can use it.
Dig into the unique characteristics of Apple Card, Apple Cash, and Apple Savings.
Export statement data from Apple Card, Apple Cash, and Apple Savings to import into financial management apps.
Explore the nuances of how features and limitations vary for using Apple Pay on an iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
Manage and use passes that give you access to an event (such as a concert or movie).
Board a plane, train, or other scheduled transit with a digital pass.
Set a payment card for express transit entry for systems that support Apple Pay—and even use it when your phone is on reserve power.
Install transit network cards.
Understand where the Wallet & Apple Pay settings on iPad and Mac fit in with the iPhone and Apple Watch Wallet app.
Get the advantages of store and other loyalty and reward cards without carrying a zillion pieces of plastic.
Create a digital ID from a U.S. driver’s license (in some states), or a limited digital version of your U.S. passport for TSA entry.
Track Apple Pay orders gleaned from your various Apple devices.
Discover where Apple stows preauthorized payments made with Apple Pay, and how to manage them.

Glenn Fleishman te lleva a través de todo lo que Wallet puede hacer, que ha crecido mucho a lo largo de los años. Aprende a añadir y gestionar tarjetas de pago, rastrear pedidos, trabajar con claves digitales, instalar pases de tránsito y mucho más.

¿Un libro sobre Wallet? ¿En serio? ¿Me estás tirando la pierna? ¿No debería ser una aplicación que sólo tiene tarjetas de pago y tarjetas de almacén/miembrosía lo suficientemente simples para usar sin un libro de 100 páginas?

Mira, eso es lo que pensamos, también, pero seguimos corriendo contra los puntos de dolor en Wallet para iPhone y Apple Watch, junto con los matices de Apple Pay, que nos llevó atrás. Y seguimos encontrando rasgos obscurecidos que teníamos que buscar. En particular, tanto el autor Glenn Fleishman como el editor Joe Kissell continuaron diciendo “huh!” y luego documentando ese “huh” para que no lo digas también.

Al final, Glenn disecciona Wallet, desmontando sus piezas virtuales, por lo que puede utilizar más de su sorprendentemente rico conjunto de ofrendas, y evitar chocar contra lo que no hace, en particular cuando no hay error o retroalimentación sobre por qué no funciona.

Mientras que la aplicación Wallet del iPhone abulta más con características y opciones, Glenn cubre a fondo la aplicación Wallet en el Apple Watch. También explica dónde encajan los ajustes Wallet & Apple Pay en un iPad y Mac, ya que también puedes utilizar y administrar Apple Pay y tarjetas autofibles en esos dos sistemas operativos.

El libro cubre estos temas:

Entiende cómo Apple organiza la cartera en un iPhone y Apple Watch.
Configure las muchas opciones de Wallet, dispersadas alrededor de la aplicación y Ajustes.
Trabaja con tarjetas de pago, explorando los detalles disponibles cuando se agrega una tarjeta.
Conoce las tarjetas AutoFill y cómo difieren de las tarjetas de pago de Apple Pay.
Aprenda sobre cómo Apple Pay protege la seguridad de la tarjeta, y las muchas maneras en que puede utilizarla.
Ingrese en las características únicas de Apple Card, Apple Cash y Apple Savings.
Datos de declaración de exportación de Apple Card, Apple Cash y Apple Savings para importar en aplicaciones de gestión financiera.
Explore los matices de cómo las características y limitaciones varían para usar Apple Pay en un iPhone, iPad, Mac y Apple Watch.
Gestionar y utilizar pases que le dan acceso a un evento (como un concierto o una película).
Junta un avión, tren u otro tránsito programado con un pase digital.
Establecer una tarjeta de pago para la entrada de tránsito expreso para sistemas que apoyen Apple Pay, e incluso utilizarla cuando su teléfono esté en el poder de reserva.
Instalar tarjetas de red de tránsito.
Entiende dónde encajan los ajustes de Wallet & Apple Pay en iPad y Mac con la aplicación iPhone y Apple Watch Wallet.
Obtenga las ventajas de la tienda y otras tarjetas de fidelidad y recompensa sin llevar un millón de piezas de plástico.
Cree una identificación digital de una licencia de conducir estadounidense (en algunos estados), o una versión digital limitada de su pasaporte estadounidense para la entrada TSA.
Pista las órdenes de Apple Pay obtenidas de sus diversos dispositivos de Apple.
Descubra dónde Manzana otorga pagos preautorizados realizados con Apple Pay, y cómo administrarlos.

Implementation Strategies: Learn best practices for implementing Microsoft HR solutions, including configuration, data migration, and user adoption strategies.
In-Depth Knowledge of Specific Products: Gain expertise in utilizing Dynamics 365 Human Resources for talent management, performance management, and more.
Leveraging Power Platform: Develop basic skills in building automated workflows, reports, and dashboards within Power Platform to enhance HR processes.
Optimizing Communication & Collaboration: Learn how to leverage Microsoft Teams and Viva Learning to foster a more engaged and connected workforce.
Strategic Use of LinkedIn: Understand how to integrate LinkedIn with Microsoft HR solutions for effective talent sourcing and employer branding.

System Integration: Gain skills in integrating Microsoft HR solutions with existing HRIS systems and other enterprise applications.

title: HBR's 10 Must Reads for New Managers, Updated and Expanded (featuring “Becoming the Boss” by Linda A. Hill)
description:
Develop the skills and mindset to successfully manage others for the first time.

If you read nothing else for new managers, read this book. We've chosen a new selection of current and classic Harvard Business Review articles that will help you get up to speed quickly, assess your team's strengths and weaknesses, and lead them to perform at their best.

This book will inspire you to:

Build trust before asserting your authority
Give constructive feedback that produces positive results
Gain buy-in for your ideas across the organization
Navigate tough conversations and high-stakes situations
Cultivate a robust network both inside and outside your organization
Lead with empathy and emotional intelligence

This collection of articles includes "Becoming the Boss," by Linda A. Hill; "What Great Managers Do," by Marcus Buckingham; "How Leaders Create and Use Networks," by Herminia Ibarra and Mark Lee Hunter; "How to Preempt Team Conflict," by Ginka Toegel and Jean-Louis Barsoux; "What Is Psychological Safety?" by Amy Gallo; "Get the Boss to Buy In," by Susan J. Ashford and James Detert; "Four Ways to Improve Your Strategic Thinking Skills," by Nina A. Bowman; "How to Help (Without Micromanaging)," by Colin M. Fisher, Teresa M. Amabile, and Julianna Pillemer; "Is Your Hybrid Team Losing Steam?" by Heidi K. Gardner; "Make the Most of Your One-on-One Meetings," by Steven G. Rogelberg; "How to Give (and Receive) Critical Feedback," by Patrick Thean; "Collaborative Overload," by Rob Cross, Reb Rebele, and Adam Grant; "The Power of Mattering at Work," by Zach Mercurio; "Leading Is Emotionally Draining. Here's How to Recover," by Dina Denham Smith; and "What Makes a Leader?" by Daniel Goleman.

HBR's 10 Must Reads are definitive collections of classic ideas, practical advice, and essential thinking from the pages of Harvard Business Review. Exploring topics like disruptive innovation, emotional intelligence, and new technology in our ever-evolving world, these books empower any leader to make bold decisions and inspire others.

This Updated and Expanded edition features new, breakthrough articles, additional short-form pieces, and a detailed discussion guide to give you and your team the tools you need for sustained success.

title: Building a Virtual Assistant for Raspberry Pi: The Practical Guide for Constructing a Voice-Controlled Virtual Assistant
description:
This new edition of Building a Virtual Assistant for Raspberry Pi will provide new features to your virtual assistant, Melissa, adding advanced capabilities to her. Updated to the latest Python release (Python 3), the book will follow the same structure as its previous edition with new features discussed as you move forward.

After walking you through the various STTs, TTSs, and implementation of these components with the Python 3, you will learn about Large Language Models (LLMs) and how to run them on Raspberry Pi. You will build applications/modules for Melissa that will be used by the LLM. The book will feature Plugin Architecture Implementation for Melissa, allowing users to script their own interactions with Melissa. You will also enable Melissa to interact with resources on the internet. In addition to Melissa's voice controlled interface for notes management, this edition will also enable Melissa to be intelligent to assist you with your tasks.

Adding to Melissa’s voice interface from the first edition, you will use an LLM to make Melissa intelligent. You will learn about function calling, providing Melissa access to tools. In conclusion, you will make a smart virtual assistant that runs on Raspberry Pi. 

What You'll Learn

Implement plugin architecture to enable quicker scripting
Develop modules for conversational interaction with the assistant
Run the local LLM instance to empower Melissa with intelligence
Interact with both public and restricted APIs (Application Programming Interfaces)

Who This Book Is For

Anyone who has built a home automation project with Raspberry Pi and now want to enhance it by making it voice-controlled. The book would also interest students from computer science or related disciplines.
translatedDescription:
Esta nueva edición de Building a Virtual Assistant for Raspberry Pi proporcionará nuevas características a su asistente virtual, Melissa, añadiendo capacidades avanzadas a ella. Actualizado a la última versión de Python (Python 3), el libro seguirá la misma estructura que su edición anterior con nuevas características discutidas mientras avanza.

Después de caminar a través de los diversos STTs, TTSs y la implementación de estos componentes con el Python 3, usted aprenderá acerca de los modelos de lenguaje grande (LLMs) y cómo ejecutarlos en Raspberry Pi. Usted construirá aplicaciones/módulos para Melissa que será utilizado por el LLM. El libro contará con Implementación de Arquitectura de Plugin para Melissa, permitiendo a los usuarios script sus propias interacciones con Melissa. También permitirá que Melissa interactúe con recursos en Internet. Además de la interfaz controlada por voz de Melissa para la gestión de notas, esta edición también permitirá que Melissa sea inteligente para ayudarle con sus tareas.

Añadiendo a la interfaz de voz de Melissa desde la primera edición, usarás un LLM para que Melissa sea inteligente. Aprenderás acerca de la función llamando, proporcionando a Melissa acceso a herramientas. En conclusión, usted hará un asistente virtual inteligente que funciona en Raspberry Pi.

Lo que aprenderás

Implementar la arquitectura plugin para habilitar scripting más rápido
Desarrollar módulos para la interacción con el asistente
Ejecute la instancia local de LLM para empoderar a Melissa con inteligencia
Interactúa con API públicas y restringidas (Interfaces de programación de aplicaciones)

Quién es este libro

Cualquier persona que haya construido un proyecto de automatización de casa con Raspberry Pi y ahora quiere mejorarlo mediante el control de voz. El libro también interesaría a estudiantes de informática o disciplinas relacionadas.

title: Lead Like The Boss
description:
Master your communication skills to become the leader you've always wanted to be

In Lead Like The Boss: The Bruce Springsteen Framework to Elevating Your Leadership, veteran strategist, marketer, and management consultant, Andy Freed, delivers a compelling and actionable message about leadership and communication for everyone expected to inspire others to perform at their best. Freed ditches the sterile, tired formulaic approach you'll find in most "leadership guides" and focuses squarely on the crux of leadership: clearly communicating with others in a way that captures their attention and persuades them to buy in.

Following the arc of Bruce "The Boss" Springsteen's legendary stage performances, the author demonstrates how to communicate your ideas to your followers and colleagues in ways that are authentic, intentional, and effective. You'll learn how to mold your communication style to match specific kinds of situations, encounters, and audiences. Lead Like The Boss shows you how to:

Prepare for specific presentations and match the content and style of your message with the feelings you're trying to bring out in your audience
Use consistent core messages to maintain alignment to company goals and vision
Focus on the things your people and your company are doing right – and thanking them appropriately – to inspire loyalty and reward exceptional performance

Perfect for managers, executives, and other business leaders, Lead Like The Boss is a must-read guide for everyone who is trying to guide their organization to the promised land of success.
translatedDescription:
Domine sus habilidades de comunicación para convertirse en el líder que siempre ha querido ser

En Lead Like The Boss: The Bruce Springsteen Framework to Elevating Your Leadership, veteran strategist, marketer, and management consultant, Andy Freed, ofrece un mensaje convincente y factible sobre liderazgo y comunicación para todos los que se espera que inspiren a otros a actuar en su mejor momento. El enfoque estéril y de fórmulas cansado encontrará en la mayoría de "guías de liderazgo" y se centra directamente en la masa de liderazgo: comunicarse claramente con otros de una manera que capta su atención y los persuade a comprar.

Siguiendo el arco de las legendarias actuaciones de Bruce "El Jefe" Springsteen, el autor demuestra cómo comunicar sus ideas a sus seguidores y colegas de maneras auténticas, intencionales y eficaces. Aprenderás a moldear tu estilo de comunicación para que coincida con tipos específicos de situaciones, encuentros y audiencias. Lead Como el Jefe le muestra cómo:

Prepárese para presentaciones específicas y coincida con el contenido y estilo de su mensaje con los sentimientos que está tratando de sacar a su audiencia
Utilizar mensajes básicos consistentes para mantener la alineación con los objetivos de la empresa y la visión
Enfócate en las cosas que tu gente y tu empresa están haciendo bien –y agradeciéndolos adecuadamente – para inspirar lealtad y recompensar un rendimiento excepcional

Perfecto para directivos, ejecutivos y otros líderes empresariales, Lead Like The Boss es una guía obligada para todos los que están tratando de guiar su organización a la tierra prometida del éxito.

title: The Game Designer's Workbook
description:
Hands-on tools, exercises, walkthroughs, and resources for new game designers. All you need is a pencil!

In The Game Designer's Workbook, two experienced game designers, Bobby Lockhart and Eric Lang, walk you through design tips and exercises you can apply immediately to take your next game to the next level. The authors draw on decades of combined experience in game design, helping you ideate, storyboard, create fun and challenging levels, and more.

The book is structured as a set of practical exercises and examples to give budding game designers hands-on experience with the nuts and bolts of designing games. Equipped only with a pencil, you can level-up your skills in critical areas of game design. While you're free to use a computer, a pair of dice, or to team up with a group of friends, The Game Designer's Workbook lets you develop your skills whenever you've got something to write with and 10 minutes of spare time.

The book includes reflection sections that allow you to think deeply about your future game design practice, challenges that prompt you to modify and improve an existing game, break down games into their component parts to better understand their inner workings, and discussions of concepts common to all sorts of games.

You'll also find:

A link to a companion website that includes additional resources, like printable resources, extra dot grid pages, papercraft exercises, random number generators, and scaffolded work pages
Explanations of cross-disciplinary skills useful for any aspiring game designers
Stand-alone chapters you can tackle beginning-to-end or one at a time

The Game Designer's Workbook is an essential toolkit for aspiring and beginning game designers, as well as anyone interested in games and game design.
translatedDescription:
Herramientas manuales, ejercicios, paseantes y recursos para nuevos diseñadores de juegos. ¡Todo lo que necesitas es un lápiz!

En The Game Designer's Workbook, dos experimentados diseñadores de juegos, Bobby Lockhart y Eric Lang, a través de consejos de diseño y ejercicios que puede aplicar inmediatamente para tomar su próximo juego al siguiente nivel. Los autores se basan en décadas de experiencia combinada en el diseño del juego, ayudándote a idear, storyboard, crear niveles divertidos y desafiantes, y mucho más.

El libro está estructurado como un conjunto de ejercicios prácticos y ejemplos para dar experiencia práctica a los diseñadores de juegos con las tuercas y los tornillos de los juegos de diseño. Equipado sólo con un lápiz, puede nivelar sus habilidades en áreas críticas de diseño del juego. Mientras usted es libre de usar una computadora, un par de dados, o para formar equipo con un grupo de amigos, The Game Designer's Workbook le permite desarrollar sus habilidades cuando usted tiene algo que escribir y 10 minutos de tiempo libre.

El libro incluye secciones de reflexión que te permiten pensar profundamente en tu futura práctica de diseño de juegos, desafíos que te impulsan a modificar y mejorar un juego existente, romper los juegos en sus partes componentes para comprender mejor sus trabajos internos, y discusiones de conceptos comunes a todo tipo de juegos.

También encontrará:

Un enlace a un sitio web de acompañantes que incluye recursos adicionales, como recursos imprimibles, páginas extra de cuadrícula de puntos, ejercicios de papelería, generadores de números aleatorios y páginas de trabajo andamiadas
Explicaciones de habilidades interdisciplinarias útiles para cualquier aspirante a los diseñadores de juegos
Capítulos independientes que puedes abordar de principio a fin o uno a la vez

El Game Designer's Workbook es una herramienta esencial para aspirantes y diseñadores de juegos de inicio, así como cualquier persona interesada en juegos y diseño de juegos.

Each chapter offers hands-on insights into managing Loop components, customizing advanced features, and integrating seamlessly into your daily workflows. Whether you're exploring Kanban boards and page linking or establishing best practices for project collaboration, this book equips you with the skills and strategies to maximize productivity and work smarter.

After reading this book, you will be able to create, share, and manage Loop components effectively. 

What You Will Learn:

Loop integration with other Microsoft 365 tools like Teams, Outlook, and OneNote
Benefits of using Loop for team collaboration and productivity
Understanding advanced strategies for maximizing productivity and collaboration using Loop
Tips and tricks to get the most out of Microsoft Loop
Best practices for adopting Microsoft Loop

Who This Book Is For:

Project managers and IT professionals for implementing and managing Microsoft 365 tools within their organization.

title: Blockchain Fundamental Analysis for Digital Asset Investors: A Guide to Minimizing Risk and Maximizing Returns
description:
Without a solid, robust procedure to evaluate digital asset investments, decisions are often made based on hype or influencer reviews, which, in the end, is nothing short of a lottery ticket. This book aims to equip new and existing digital asset investors with the skills and abilities to help identify, evaluate, and ultimately invest in fundamentally strong crypto projects. Possessing such skills helps reduce investor risk, increases profits, and overall helps to maintain long-term success.  

You’ll start with an introduction to blockchain technology and digital assets before starting with the fundamental elements.). In a nutshell, blockchain fundamentals are the core and heart of the technology, but they also expand to various aspects that directly influence a projects value and corresponding digital asset. Many areas fall under the umbrella of blockchain fundamentals, including the underlying technology, distributed ledger technology, decentralization, cryptographic hash functions, transaction blocks, consensus mechanisms, immutability, smart contracts, and tokens and cryptocurrency (coins). 

While these major components are discussed and explored, they alone are not enough for you to make well-informed investment decisions. Therefore, this book digs deep into 13 key pillars—covering additional areas like the project team, governance, roadmap, practical use cases, codebase, funding and many other fundamental aspects—that help guide digital asset investors to success. Each fundamental element is discussed in detail with case studies to visually demonstrate the evaluation process. 

What You Will Learn 

·       How investors can grow and strengthen their skill set and awareness to identify high-quality projects with solid fundamentals, while avoiding lesser or potentially fraudulent ventures.

·       How to analyze and assess fundamental elements such as the project documentation, value offering, technical architecture, and the team, while considering market fit and community engagement.

·       How token design—from supply metrics and distribution to underlying utility—offers invaluable insights for evaluating a projects sustainability, growth potential, and real-world adoption.

Who This Book is For

This book is for anyone interested in investing in digital assets—no prior knowledge is required. Its clear, easy-to-follow approach makes it ideal for both beginners and intermediate-level readers.

Este libro pretende dotar a los inversores digitales de activos nuevos y existentes de las habilidades y habilidades para ayudar a identificar, evaluar y, en última instancia, invertir en proyectos criptográficos fundamentalmente fuertes. Comenzarás con una introducción a la tecnología de blockchain y los activos digitales antes de empezar con los elementos fundamentales.). En pocas palabras, los fundamentos de blockchain son el núcleo y el corazón de la tecnología, pero también se expanden a diversos aspectos que influyen directamente en el valor de los proyectos y el activo digital correspondiente. Muchas áreas están bajo el paraguas de los fundamentos de la cadena de bloques, incluyendo la tecnología subyacente, tecnología de ledger distribuida, descentralización, funciones de hash criptográfico, bloques de transacción, mecanismos de consenso, inmutabilidad, contratos inteligentes, fichas y criptomonedas (coins).

Mientras estos componentes principales se discuten y exploran, ellos solos no son suficientes para que usted tome decisiones de inversión bien informadas. Por lo tanto, este libro profundiza en 13 pilares clave —que cubren áreas adicionales como el equipo del proyecto, gobernanza, hoja de ruta, casos de uso práctico, base de código, financiación y muchos otros aspectos fundamentales— que ayudan a guiar a los inversores de activos digitales al éxito. Qué aprenderás
